data.one_liner: Provides custom InkSplash and InkRipple alternatives for button press effects.
data.what_it_does: The package offers several drop‑in splash factories that replace the default Material splash animations. It includes WaveSplash, PathSplash, LineSplash and a NoSplash option, each configurable via static factories.
use_when: You want a different visual feedback for button presses than the default InkSplash/InkRipple.
You need a quick way to customize splash appearance without writing your own painter.
avoid_when: You don't need custom splash effects and prefer the built‑in Material behavior.
You require a full UI kit or theming solution beyond splash effects.
strengths: Easy to integrate via splashFactory property
weaknesses: Few configuration options compared to building a custom splash
